description:
index.html carries a theme-color meta and nothing else: no manifest link, no icons, no public directory. A workout tracker used at the gym belongs on the home screen, not in a browser tab.

Manifest, icons and theme-color wiring only. Explicitly no offline write queue: queueing writes while failures are still invisible would hide them twice over, and the audit defers it behind error surfacing for that reason. The theme system already restamps theme-color on palette change, so the manifest must not fight it.
title: Make the app installable (PWA)
